title: TargetAdapterCapability
description: Configuration DTO for target-specific adapters (Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Hermes Agent, Kilo Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode). Defines per-target file paths, CLI invocation patterns, and native config read/write rules.

target_id.description: Unique identifier for the target adapter (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor').

capabilities.description: List of capability declarations supported by this target adapter.
